description: A community wall where app users share posts, comment and chat, while app owners moderate the conversation and decide how the wall works.

events.name: postCreated
events.description: Someone shared a new post on the wall.

wallId.description: The wall it was posted on; empty for the main wall.

isPrivateChat.description: Whether it was sent in a private chat.

postId.description: The post it was added to.

wallId.description: The wall the post is on; empty for the main wall.

events.name: postDeleted
events.description: A post was removed from the wall.

wallId.description: The wall it was on; empty for the main wall.

events.name: commentDeleted
events.description: A comment was removed from a post.

commentId.description: The removed comment's id, if it had one.

operations.name: searchPosts
operations.description: Shows the posts on the walls, newest first, with their comments and likes.

wallId.description: Only show posts on this wall. Leave it out to look through every wall, or leave it empty for the main wall.

text.description: Only show posts with exactly this text. Leave it out to show posts with any text.

userId.description: Only show this person's posts, given by their id or email. Leave it out to show everyone's posts.

page.description: Which page to show, counting from 0. Leave it out for the first page.

pageSize.description: How many posts a page holds, up to 50. Leave it out for 20.

callback.description: Runs when the search is done.

error.description: Why it didn't work, if it didn't.

wallId.description: The wall the post is on; empty for the main wall.

name.description: Their name, as the wall shows it.

imageUrl.description: Their profile picture, if they have one.

commentId.description: The comment's id, if it has one.

name.description: Their name, as the wall shows it.

imageUrl.description: Their profile picture, if they have one.

total.description: How many posts match in all.

page.description: Which page this is, counting from 0.

hasMore.description: Whether there are more posts after this page.

operations.name: deletePost
operations.description: Permanently removes a post and its comments from the wall.

postText.description: The exact text of the post to remove.

userId.description: The person who posted it, given by their id or email. Leave it out to look through everyone's posts.

wallId.description: The wall the post is on. Leave it out to look through every wall, or leave it empty for the main wall.

callback.description: Runs when the post is removed.

error.description: Why it wasn't removed, such as no post or several posts having that text.

operations.name: deletePostAdvanced
operations.description: Permanently removes a post and its comments from the wall, using the post's id.

postId.description: The post's id, as shown in search results.

callback.description: Runs when the post is removed.

error.description: Why it wasn't removed, such as no post having that id.

operations.name: deletePostsAdvanced
operations.description: Permanently removes several posts and their comments at once, up to 50.

posts.description: The posts to remove, up to 50 at a time.

postId.description: The post's id, as shown in search results.

callback.description: Runs when all the posts are done.

error.description: Why nothing was removed, such as a post that no longer exists.

posts.description: One result per post, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which post this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The removed post's id, if it was removed.

error.description: Why it wasn't removed, if it wasn't.

operations.name: deleteComment
operations.description: Permanently removes a comment from a post.

commentText.description: The exact text of the comment to remove.

postText.description: The exact text of the post the comment is on. Leave it out to look through every post.

userId.description: The person who wrote the comment, given by their id or email. Leave it out to look through everyone's comments.

callback.description: Runs when the comment is removed.

error.description: Why it wasn't removed, such as no comment or several comments having that text.

commentId.description: The removed comment's id, if it had one.

operations.name: deleteCommentAdvanced
operations.description: Permanently removes a comment from a post, using the post's and the comment's ids.

postId.description: The id of the post the comment is on, as shown in search results.

commentId.description: The comment's id, as shown in search results.

callback.description: Runs when the comment is removed.

error.description: Why it wasn't removed, such as no comment having that id on that post.

commentId.description: The removed comment's id, if it had one.

operations.name: deleteCommentsAdvanced
operations.description: Permanently removes several comments at once, up to 50.

comments.description: The comments to remove, up to 50 at a time.

postId.description: The id of the post the comment is on, as shown in search results.

commentId.description: The comment's id, as shown in search results.

callback.description: Runs when all the comments are done.

error.description: Why nothing was removed, such as a comment that no longer exists.

comments.description: One result per comment, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which comment this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The removed comment's id, if it was removed.

error.description: Why it wasn't removed, if it wasn't.

operations.name: searchMembers
operations.description: Shows the people who are members of a wall.

wallId.description: The wall whose members are shown. Leave it out, or leave it empty, for the main wall.

name.description: Only show members whose name or email contains this text. Leave it out to show every member.

page.description: Which page to show, counting from 0. Leave it out for the first page.

pageSize.description: How many members a page holds, up to 50. Leave it out for 50.

callback.description: Runs when the search is done.

error.description: Why it didn't work, if it didn't.

displayName.description: Their display name, if they have one.

firstName.description: Their first name, if they have one.

lastName.description: Their last name, if they have one.

imageUrl.description: Their profile picture, if they have one.

total.description: How many members match in all.

page.description: Which page this is, counting from 0.

hasMore.description: Whether there are more members after this page.
